_comment: Bus doors for the walking passengers (jobs/bus/paxWalkers.lua). Keyed by JBeam model; each door is the average of fixed frame nodes that do not move when the door opens. role: board, alight or both. Add-on buses can ship their own gameplay/overhaul/bus/doors_<name>.json with the same layout; later files add models. Models not listed use the fallback, built from the vehicle's bounding box on the stop's curb side.

md_series._comment: School, prison and derby buses: the front door hinge edges (schoolbus_door_F); the rear door is a raised emergency exit, so it is not used.
